title: Breath effects: burn and corrode
note: Design doc §3: Fire sets a lane burning along its line through Close and Far, as wide as the blast; Earth corrodes the target, which then takes +3 from every hit. Burning ground hits grounded dragons standing in it at slot's end and lingers Potency ÷ 6 slots (more for a charged Breath); a burn deals Potency ÷ 4, ±3 by the element wheel. A True Dragon's own fire never harms it. Corrosion lasts Potency ÷ 6 slots, and each hit on the corroded dragon fills the attacker's Acumen meter. (Water's push and Air's pull are in push-and-shove.json.)
